annotations.title: Publish or schedule a post (goes live)

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] `altText` overrides image descriptions for this booking: one string per image (array for a carousel). PUBLISHES TO REAL SOCIAL ACCOUNTS. Posts now, or at `scheduledAt` (ISO-8601, future). Prefer `contentId` (a draft from create_content: its text and media become the post) over inline `content`. The post goes out through the target brand's own connected accounts. Always pass an `idempotencyKey` so a retry never double-posts. More optional arguments, not listed: followUpComments, instanceLabels, youtube, poll, firstComment, images, instagram, pinterest, onBooked, dryRun, labels, facebook, reshare, memo, mediaCampaignId, requiresApproval, dropMediaLessPlatforms, strictMedia, allowDuplicateBooking, autoFirstComment, onPublishTasks, aiGenerated. Full description and schema: describe_tool {"name":"publish"}.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/publish.)

altText.description: Format: JSON; e.g. "Example". Several shapes; describe_tool shows them.

idempotencyKey.description: Format: string; e.g. "Example". Unique per API key.

platforms.description: Format: array; e.g. ["instagram"]. One of 16 values, e.g. "instagram", "tiktok", "youtube".
